name: vult-label-backend
description: Medusa store backend for the VULT LABEL site: products, stock, carts and orders.

scripts.start:production: cd .medusa/server && npm run predeploy && npm run start
scripts.predeploy: medusa db:migrate && medusa exec ./src/scripts/seed.js && (test -z "$ADMIN_EMAIL" || medusa user -e "$ADMIN_EMAIL" -p "$ADMIN_PASSWORD" || true)
